"""R8 inference-only score geometry. Inputs: complete character-normalized LLs.

No labels, model calls, fitting, answer text or token-level reconstruction.
These are known projection operations used on a new per-question score repair;
orthogonality/halfspace protection does not guarantee preservation of answers.
"""
import numpy as np

EPS=64*np.finfo(np.float64).eps
METHODS=('keep_r6_axis','nonundo_r6_axis','late_orthogonal','late_unprotected',
         'matched_keep','matched_nonundo','matched_late')


def finite(*values):
    if any(not np.isfinite(v).all() for v in values):raise ValueError('Nonfinite R8 input/intermediate/output')


def center(value):
    value=np.asarray(value,dtype=np.float64);finite(value)
    shifted=value-value[0];return shifted-shifted.mean()


def norm(value):
    value=np.asarray(value,dtype=np.float64);m=float(np.max(np.abs(value)))
    return 0. if m==0 else m*float(np.sqrt(np.dot(value/m,value/m)))


def unit(value,reference_scale=0.):
    n=norm(value)
    if n==0. or n<=EPS*reference_scale:return None
    return value/n


def projection(value,axis):
    return np.zeros_like(value) if axis is None else float(value@axis)*axis


def bounded_beta(value,direction):
    size=norm(direction)
    if size==0.:return 0.
    n=float(value@(direction/size))
    return 0. if n<=0. else 1. if n>=size else n/size


def selected_score(a,r,m2,late,prior_late,method):
    if method not in METHODS:raise ValueError('Unknown R8 recipe')
    a,r,m2,late=[np.asarray(v,dtype=np.float64) for v in (a,r,m2,late)]
    assert a.ndim==1 and a.size>=2 and all(v.shape==a.shape for v in [r,m2,late]);finite(a,r,m2,late)
    c=center(r-a);caxis=unit(c,max(norm(center(r)),norm(center(a))))
    d=center(m2-r);pc=projection(d,caxis)
    keep=d-pc
    nonundo=d-projection(d,caxis) if caxis is not None and float(d@caxis)<0. else d.copy()
    diag=dict(protected_axis_active=caxis is not None,protected_axis_norm=norm(c),
        raw_increment_norm=norm(d),raw_increment_dot_axis=float(d@caxis) if caxis is not None else 0.)
    if method in ['keep_r6_axis','nonundo_r6_axis','matched_keep','matched_nonundo']:
        repaired=keep if method in ['keep_r6_axis','matched_keep'] else nonundo
        ratio=1. if norm(d)==0 else norm(repaired)/norm(d)
        assert ratio<=1.+1e-12
        delta=ratio*d if method.startswith('matched_') else repaired
        diag.update(norm_ratio=ratio,repaired_increment_norm=norm(repaired))
    else:
        if prior_late is None:raise ValueError('Late prior P5 is required; no silent fallback')
        h=center(prior_late);assert h.shape==a.shape;finite(h)
        ell=center(late);ell_perp=ell-projection(ell,caxis)
        residual=h-projection(h,caxis)
        if norm(residual)<=np.sqrt(EPS)*norm(h):residual=np.zeros_like(h)
        if norm(ell_perp)<=EPS*norm(ell):ell_perp=np.zeros_like(ell_perp)
        if method=='late_unprotected':
            beta=bounded_beta(ell,h);delta=-beta*h
        else:
            beta=bounded_beta(ell_perp,residual)
            after=ell_perp-beta*residual
            rho=1. if norm(ell_perp)==0 else norm(after)/norm(ell_perp)
            assert rho<=1.+1e-12
            delta=(rho-1.)*ell_perp if method=='matched_late' else -beta*residual
            diag.update(norm_ratio=rho,late_residual_before_norm=norm(ell_perp),late_residual_after_norm=norm(after))
        diag.update(beta=beta,prior_late_norm=norm(h),orthogonal_prior_late_norm=norm(residual))
    output=r+delta;finite(output,delta)
    diag.update(applied_increment_norm=norm(center(delta)),applied_increment_dot_axis=float(center(delta)@caxis) if caxis is not None else 0.)
    return output,diag

"""New round, same folder; own data gates, immutable R7 authorities."""
import csv,hashlib,itertools,json
from r7_core import ROOT,sha,read,digest,jsonlines


def save(relative,value):
    p=ROOT/relative;assert p.name.startswith('r8_') and p.parent.is_dir() and p.resolve().is_relative_to(ROOT.resolve())
    tmp=p.with_suffix(p.suffix+'.tmp');tmp.write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf8');tmp.replace(p)


def csvout(relative,values):
    p=ROOT/relative;assert p.name.startswith('r8_') and p.parent.is_dir()
    with p.open('w',newline='',encoding='utf8') as stream:
        w=csv.DictWriter(stream,fieldnames=list(dict.fromkeys(k for row in values for k in row)));w.writeheader();w.writerows(values)


def load_rows(split,need_p5=True):
    protocol=read('configs/r8_PROTOCOL.json')
    if split=='confirmation':assert read('configs/r8_CANDIDATE_LOCK.json')['status']=='frozen_before_current_confirmation'
    elif split=='validation':assert read('configs/r8_VALIDATION_LOCK.json')['status']=='frozen_before_current_validation'
    elif split=='test':assert read('configs/r8_FINAL_METHOD_LOCK.json')['test_access_authorized']
    else:assert split in ['discovery','selection']
    assert sha('data/slcd_'+split+'.jsonl')==protocol['dataset_sha256'][split]
    suffix='_development' if split in ['discovery','selection','confirmation'] else '_final'
    path='results/r7_'+split+suffix+'.jsonl';receipt=read(path.replace('.jsonl','_COMPLETE.json'))
    assert receipt['status']=='complete' and sha(path)==receipt['score_file_sha256']
    assert receipt['score_file_sha256']==protocol['r7_score_file_sha256'][split]
    data=list(jsonlines(path));expected_n={'discovery':384,'selection':192,'confirmation':517,'validation':299,'test':1172}[split]
    assert len(data)==len({r['id'] for r in data})==expected_n
    manifests={r['id']:r for r in jsonlines('data/slcd_'+split+'.jsonl')};assert set(manifests)=={r['id'] for r in data}
    prior={}
    if split in ['discovery','selection','confirmation']:
        p='results/slcd_r5_priors_train.jsonl';pr=read(p.replace('.jsonl','_COMPLETE.json'));assert sha(p)==pr['score_file_sha256']
        with (ROOT/p).open(encoding='utf8') as stream:
            source=stream if split=='confirmation' else itertools.islice(stream,576)
            prior={r['id']:r for r in map(json.loads,source)}
    elif split=='test' and need_p5:
        p='results/slcd_r6_priors_test.jsonl';pr=read(p.replace('.jsonl','_COMPLETE.json'));assert sha(p)==pr['score_file_sha256']
        prior={r['id']:r for r in jsonlines(p)}
    elif split=='validation' and need_p5:
        pr=read('results/r8_validation_prior5_COMPLETE.json');assert pr['status']=='complete'
        assert sha(pr['score_file'])==pr['score_file_sha256'];prior={r['id']:r for r in jsonlines(pr['score_file'])}
    result=[]
    import numpy as np
    from slcd_r6_scores import selected_score
    for row in data:
        assert row['signature']==receipt['signature'];item=manifests[row['id']]
        assert row['prompt_sha256']==item['prompt_sha256'] and row['gold']==item['gold'] and row['choice_char_lengths']==item['choice_char_lengths']
        pm=row['prior_methods'][0]
        if row['id'] in prior:
            pp=prior[row['id']];assert pp['prompt_sha256']==item['prompt_sha256'] and pp['gold']==item['gold'] and pp['choice_char_lengths']==item['choice_char_lengths']
            if 'prior_methods' in pp:pm=pp['prior_methods']
            else:pm={**pm,'native_k5':dict(normalized_scores=(np.asarray(pp['P5_sum_scores'])/np.asarray(item['choice_char_lengths'])).tolist())}
        vec=lambda methods,key:np.asarray(methods[key]['normalized_scores'],dtype=np.float64)
        original=row['original_methods'];r=np.asarray(row['baseline_scores']['M0_R6']);a=np.asarray(row['baseline_scores']['A1'])
        assert np.array_equal(r,selected_score(original,pm,'r6_prior_projection'))
        h=vec(pm,'native_k4')-vec(pm,'native_k5') if need_p5 else None
        result.append(dict(id=row['id'],gold=row['gold'],split=split,item=item,
            a=a,r=r,m2=np.asarray(row['method_scores']['M2_N0_token']),late=vec(original,'native_k4')-vec(original,'native_k5'),prior_late=h,
            baseline_scores=row['baseline_scores'],historical_M1=row['method_scores'].get('M1_multi_candidate'),
            source_score_sha256=receipt['score_file_sha256']))
    return result

"""Finite CPU method comparisons. All inference arguments are label-free vectors."""
import argparse,time
import numpy as np
from r8_core import ROOT,sha,read,save,csvout,load_rows
from r8_scores import selected_score


def summary(data,method):
    base=np.asarray([r['base_correct'] for r in data]);new=np.asarray([r['correct'][method] for r in data])
    special=np.asarray([r['base_correct'] and not r['fixed_correct'] for r in data])
    return dict(method=method,n=len(data),correct=int(new.sum()),R6_correct=int(base.sum()),rescue=int((new&~base).sum()),damage=int((base&~new).sum()),
        net=int(new.sum()-base.sum()),retained_R6_vs_Fixed_rescues=int((new&special).sum()),total_R6_vs_Fixed_rescues=int(special.sum()))


def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--split',choices=['development','confirmation','validation','test'],required=True);a=p.parse_args();start=time.time()
    cfg=read('configs/r8_METHODS.json');names=list(cfg['methods'])
    if a.split=='validation':names=read('configs/r8_VALIDATION_LOCK.json')['candidates']
    elif a.split=='test':names=[read('configs/r8_FINAL_METHOD_LOCK.json')['primary']]
    if a.split in ['confirmation','validation','test']:
        lock=read('configs/r8_FINAL_METHOD_LOCK.json' if a.split=='test' else 'configs/r8_CANDIDATE_LOCK.json')
        assert lock['methods_sha256']==sha('configs/r8_METHODS.json')
        for n,value in lock['source_sha256'].items():assert sha('scripts/'+n)==value
    splits=['discovery','selection'] if a.split=='development' else [a.split];records=[]
    need_p5=any(n.startswith('late_') or n=='matched_late' for n in names)
    for split in splits:
        for row in load_rows(split,need_p5=need_p5):
            baseline=row['baseline_scores'];preds={k:int(np.argmax(v)) for k,v in baseline.items()};scores={};diagnostics={}
            if row['historical_M1'] is not None:preds['historical_R7_M1']=int(np.argmax(row['historical_M1']))
            preds['historical_R7_M2']=int(np.argmax(row['m2']))
            for name in names:
                values,d=selected_score(row['a'],row['r'],row['m2'],row['late'],row['prior_late'],name)
                scores[name]=values.tolist();preds[name]=int(values.argmax());diagnostics[name]=d
            gold=row['gold'];records.append(dict(id=row['id'],split=split,gold=gold,predictions=preds,
                correct={k:v==gold for k,v in preds.items()},method_scores=scores,diagnostics=diagnostics,
                base_correct=preds['M0_R6']==gold,fixed_correct=preds['fixed']==gold,source_score_sha256=row['source_score_sha256']))
    output=f'results/r8_{a.split}_scores.jsonl'
    assert not (ROOT/output).exists(),'An existing attempt must be inspected, not overwritten'
    with (ROOT/output).open('x',encoding='utf8') as stream:
        import json
        for row in records:stream.write(json.dumps(row,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
    table=[]
    groups=[(s,[r for r in records if r['split']==s]) for s in splits]
    if len(splits)>1:groups.append((a.split,records))
    for label,subset in groups:
        if not subset:continue
        for name in list(subset[0]['predictions']):table.append(dict(split=label,**summary(subset,name)))
    csvout(f'results/r8_{a.split}_results.csv',table)
    save(f'results/r8_{a.split}_COMPLETE.json',dict(status='complete',n=len(records),methods=names,score_file=output,score_file_sha256=sha(output),
        methods_sha256=sha('configs/r8_METHODS.json'),source_sha256={n:sha('scripts/'+n) for n in ['r8_scores.py','r8_core.py','r8_evaluate.py']},
        elapsed_seconds=time.time()-start,CPU_only=True,summary=[r for r in table if r['split']==a.split]))
    print('R8_COMPLETE',a.split,[r for r in table if r['split']==a.split],flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Synthetic structural checks before development feedback; no model/data."""
import numpy as np
from r8_scores import METHODS,selected_score,center,norm,unit
from r8_core import sha,save


def main():
    rng=np.random.default_rng(2021);checks=[];max_protected=0.;max_match=0.
    for _ in range(100):
        n=4;a=rng.normal(size=n);r=a+rng.normal(size=n);m=r+rng.normal(size=n);ell=rng.normal(size=n);h=rng.normal(size=n)
        values={name:selected_score(a,r,m,ell,h,name) for name in METHODS};c=unit(center(r-a))
        for name,(score,d) in values.items():
            assert np.isfinite(score).all() and np.isclose(score.mean(),r.mean(),atol=2e-14)
            shifted,_=selected_score(a+8,r+8,m+8,ell,h,name);assert np.allclose(shifted,score+8,atol=2e-13)
            p=rng.permutation(n);permuted,_=selected_score(a[p],r[p],m[p],ell[p],h[p],name);assert np.allclose(permuted,score[p],atol=2e-13)
        for name in ['keep_r6_axis','late_orthogonal','matched_late']:
            err=abs(center(values[name][0]-r)@c);max_protected=max(max_protected,err);assert err<=2e-13
        assert center(values['nonundo_r6_axis'][0]-r)@c>=-2e-13
        for original,control in [('keep_r6_axis','matched_keep'),('nonundo_r6_axis','matched_nonundo')]:
            err=abs(norm(center(values[original][0]-r))-norm(center(values[control][0]-r)));max_match=max(max_match,err);assert err<=2e-13
        for name in ['keep_r6_axis','nonundo_r6_axis']:assert norm(center(values[name][0]-r))<=norm(center(m-r))+2e-13
    checks+=['full axis preservation','nonundo halfspace','increment norms do not expand','matched increment norms',
             'score gauge shift','choice permutation','finite outputs','mean score preserved']
    a=np.zeros(4);r=np.array([1.,-1.,0.,0.]);m=r.copy();ell=np.zeros(4);h=np.zeros(4)
    for name in METHODS:assert np.array_equal(selected_score(a,r,m,ell,h,name)[0],r)
    checks.append('zero signal exact R6')
    ell=np.array([2.,-2.,0.,0.]);h=ell.copy()
    assert np.array_equal(selected_score(a,r,m,ell,h,'late_orthogonal')[0],r)
    checks.append('collinear protected late axis resolves to zero')
    try:selected_score(a,r,np.full(4,np.nan),ell,h,'keep_r6_axis')
    except ValueError:checks.append('nonfinite errors are rejected')
    else:raise AssertionError('Nonfinite input accepted')
    save('results/r8_MATH_CHECKS.json',dict(status='passed',checks=checks,random_cases=100,max_axis_error=max_protected,max_matched_norm_error=max_match,
        scope='CPU score geometry only, not empirical accuracy or token-logit reconstruction',source_sha256={n:sha('scripts/'+n) for n in ['r8_scores.py','r8_checks.py']}))
    print('R8_MATH_CHECKS_PASSED',max_protected,max_match,flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':main()
